flowContents.comments: Incremental pull from Oracle GL_BALANCES with ORA_HASH chunking (50 chunks, 10 threads), CKEY generation, and MERGE using 6-column logical key with NULL-safe TRANSLATED_FLAG.
flowContents.name: Oracle JDBC Connector - MultiTable

source.name: Create Staging Table IF NOT EXISTS
Create Staging Table IF NOT EXISTS

destination.name: Create Staging Table IF NOT EXISTS

properties.SQL Query:
SELECT
  'MERGE INTO #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.${target_table} T '
  || 'USING (SELECT * FROM #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.${staging_table} '
  || 'QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "CKEY" ORDER BY "${merge_order_column}" DESC) = 1) S '
  || 'ON T."CKEY" = S."CKEY" '
  || 'WHEN MATCHED AND HASH('
  || LISTAGG('T."' || COLUMN_NAME || '"', ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION)
  || ') <> HASH('
  || LISTAGG('S."' || COLUMN_NAME || '"', ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION)
  || ') THEN UPDATE SET '
  || LISTAGG('T."' || COLUMN_NAME || '" = S."' || COLUMN_NAME || '"', ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION)
  || ', T."_UPDATED_AT" = SYSDATE()'
  || ' WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ("CKEY", '
  || LISTAGG('"' || COLUMN_NAME || '"', ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION)
  || ', "_INSERTED_AT", "_UPDATED_AT") VALUES (S."CKEY", '
  || LISTAGG('S."' || COLUMN_NAME || '"', ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ORDINAL_POSITION)
  || ', SYSDATE(), SYSDATE())' AS MERGE_SQL
FROM #{Destination Database}.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS
WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '#{Destination Schema}'
  AND TABLE_NAME = '${staging_table}'
  AND COLUMN_NAME != 'CKEY'

processors.name: Create Staging Table IF NOT EXISTS

properties.SQL Query: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.${staging_table} USING TEMPLATE (SELECT ARRAY_AGG(CASE WHEN "TYPE" LIKE 'NUMBER%' THEN OBJECT_CONSTRUCT('COLUMN_NAME', "COLUMN_NAME", 'TYPE', 'NUMBER(38,0)', 'NULLABLE', "NULLABLE") ELSE OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*) END) FROM TABLE(INFER_SCHEMA(LOCATION=>'@#{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.#{Snowflake Internal Stage}/${source_table}/', FILE_FORMAT=>'#{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.OPENFLOW_JSON_FORMAT')))

INSERT INTO #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.INCREMENTAL_WATERMARK (TABLE_NAME, WATERMARK_VALUE, STATUS, ROWS_LOADED) SELECT '${source_table}', (SELECT ${watermark_select}::VARCHAR FROM #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.${target_table}), 'SUCCESS', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.${staging_table})
properties.SQL Post-Query: TRUNCATE TABLE IF EXISTS #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.${staging_table}

properties.SQL Query: COPY INTO #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.${staging_table} FROM @#{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.#{Snowflake Internal Stage}/${source_table}/ FILE_FORMAT = (TYPE = 'JSON' STRIP_OUTER_ARRAY = TRUE) MATCH_BY_COLUMN_NAME = CASE_INSENSITIVE PURGE = TRUE

properties.Log Message: Oracle Incremental Pull FAILED for ${source_table}. Error: ${executesql.error.message}

processGroups.name: Extract Data and Load to Stage

properties.SQL Query: TRUNCATE TABLE IF EXISTS #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.${staging_table}

properties.SQL Post-Query: CREATE FILE FORMAT IF NOT EXISTS #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.OPENFLOW_JSON_FORMAT TYPE = 'JSON' STRIP_OUTER_ARRAY = TRUE
properties.SQL Pre-Query: CREATE STAGE IF NOT EXISTS #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.#{Snowflake Internal Stage}

properties.SQL Query: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(WATERMARK_VALUE), '1900-01-01 00:00:00') AS LAST_WATERMARK FROM #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.INCREMENTAL_WATERMARK WHERE TABLE_NAME = '${source_table}' AND STATUS = 'SUCCESS'
properties.SQL Pre-Query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS #{Destination Database}.#{Destination Schema}.INCREMENTAL_WATERMARK (
    ID              NUMBER AUTOINCREMENT,
    TABLE_NAME      VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL,
    WATERMARK_VALUE VARCHAR(256),
    STATUS          VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,  -- 'SUCCESS' or 'FAILED'
    ROWS_LOADED     NUMBER,
    DURATION_SEC    NUMBER,
    ERROR_MESSAGE   VARCHAR(4000),
    RUN_TS          TIMESTAMP_NTZ DEFAULT SYSDATE(),
    PRIMARY KEY (ID)
);

properties.Log Message: Oracle Incremental Pull FAILED for ${source_table}. Error: ${executesql.error.message}

parameters.description: The database where data will be persisted. It must already exist in Snowflake
parameters.name: Destination Database

parameters.description:
Do not change after initial start of the connector.

A pattern for schemas where data will be persisted. The schemas will be created by the connector if they don't exist.

You can customize it for each ingested table with optional variables:
${source.database.name} - a table's source database;
${source.schema.name} - a table's source schema;
${source.table.name} - a source table's name.

E.g. for a table with qualified name "source_db.tenant_a.data" the pattern "prefix_${source.database.name}_${source.schema.name}" will evaluate to "prefix_source_db_tenant_a". 

If you wish to ingest all tables into a single schema, provide a desired schema name without any variables.
parameters.name: Destination Schema Pattern

parameters.description: Determines how the connector handles invalid rows - rows that Snowflake rejects during ingestion because they cannot be written to the destination table (for example, a value that cannot be converted to the destination column's type, or a missing required column). 'Fail Table' stops replicating the table and marks it as failed on the first invalid row. 'Log Errors and Continue' keeps replicating the valid rows and records each rejected row, together with its original payload and error details, in the table's error table.
parameters.name: Error Handling Strategy

parameters.description: Only applicable when 'Table Storage Format' is set to 'ICEBERG'. Do not change after initial start of the connector. Specifies the Iceberg version for the destination Iceberg table (Preview Feature). Supported values are 2 and 3, and this defaults to 3. Leaving this blank falls back to the Iceberg version configured on the destination database; this behavior should not be used and will be removed in a future release.
parameters.name: Iceberg Version

parameters.description: Determines how to handle values exceeding internal connector size limits. One of: Pass Through / Fail Table / Set Null
parameters.name: Oversized Value Strategy

parameters.description: Snowflake account name formatted as [organization-name]-[account-name] where data will be persisted
parameters.name: Snowflake Account Identifier

parameters.description: Using SNOWFLAKE_MANAGED will make use of the Snowflake managed token associated with the specified Snowflake Runtime Role. If using Openflow BYOC, it is also possible to use KEY_PAIR in order to specify a specific user and role via a custom Key Pair.
parameters.name: Snowflake Authentication Strategy

parameters.description: When using KEY_PAIR, specify the strategy for connecting to Snowflake. Possible values: STANDARD, PRIVATE_CONNECTIVITY
parameters.name: Snowflake Connection Strategy

parameters.description: The RSA private key which is used for authentication. The RSA key must be formatted according to PKCS8 standards and have standard PEM headers and footers. Note that either Snowflake Private Key File or Snowflake Private Key must be defined
parameters.name: Snowflake Private Key

parameters.description: The file that contains the RSA Private Key used for authentication to Snowflake, formatted according to PKCS8 standards and having standard PEM headers and footers. The header line starts with -----BEGIN PRIVATE
parameters.name: Snowflake Private Key File

parameters.description: The password associated with the Snowflake Private Key File
parameters.name: Snowflake Private Key Password

parameters.description: Snowflake Role used during query execution
parameters.name: Snowflake Role

parameters.name: Snowflake Username

parameters.description: Snowflake warehouse used to run queries
parameters.name: Snowflake Warehouse

parameters.name: Table Storage Format

parameters.name: Chunk Count

parameters.description: JSON array, one object per table. Required: source_schema, source_table, watermark_column. Optional: target_table (default source_table), staging_table (default <target_table>_STG), ckey_expression (default ROWID), chunk_count (default #{Chunk Count}), merge_order_column (default LAST_UPDATE_DATE).
